name: Mount Seir
line: Mount Seir is a hill country God gave to Esau's family, the Edomites, which Israel passed by and which God later spoke against for its hatred.

moments.title: Israel wanders near Seir
moments.text: Israel wandered around Mount Seir for many days. Then the LORD told them to turn north and not to provoke Esau's descendants, because He had given Mount Seir to Esau.

moments.title: Simeonites settle on Mount Seir
moments.text: Five hundred Simeonites went to Mount Seir and struck down the Amalekites who had escaped. The writer says they have lived there to this day.

moments.title: God speaks against Mount Seir
moments.text: The LORD told Ezekiel to speak His message against Mount Seir. He said He would turn it into an empty ruin because of its ancient hatred of Israel.
